proposal.expected_benefit: This change will prevent malicious actors from reusing intentIds with different PoI hashes to execute unintended actions on-chain.
proposal.problem: The system currently rejects duplicate PoI hashes but does not reject on-chain reuse of an intentId with a different PoI hash, which could lead to replay attacks.
proposal.proposed_change: Modify the intent validation logic to reject any intentId that has been previously used, regardless of the PoI hash, to prevent replay attacks.

risks.description: Introducing a new intentId uniqueness check may inadvertently block legitimate use cases where intentIds are reused for different PoI hashes in a valid context.
risks.mitigation: Implement a whitelist for specific intentId reuse scenarios where PoI hash changes are allowed, based on business rules.

proposal.rollback_plan: Revert the intent validation logic to its previous state if the proposed change causes unintended behavior or conflicts with existing business rules.
proposal.title: Prevent On-Chain Replay of Reused IntentId with Different PoI Hash

verification_tests.description: Attempt to submit an intent with a previously used intentId but different PoI hash and verify it is rejected.
verification_tests.expected_result: The intent submission is rejected with an error indicating intentId reuse.

verification_tests.description: Attempt to submit an intent with a previously used intentId and same PoI hash and verify it is rejected.
verification_tests.expected_result: The intent submission is rejected with an error indicating duplicate PoI hash.
